jei.fastfurnacev2.accelerator_conversion: %s–%s fully boosted conversions, depending on recipe
jei.fastfurnacev2.accelerator_no_full_co: Not enough work for one fully boosted conversion

jei.fastfurnacev2.fast_furnace: 150% speed (200% with Fast Coal; 250% with Extreme Coal) and a 10% fuel doubling chance.
jei.fastfurnacev2.iron_fast_furnace: 200% speed (250% with Fast Coal; 300% with Extreme Coal) and a 15% fuel doubling chance.
jei.fastfurnacev2.gold_fast_furnace: 250% speed (300% with Fast Coal; 350% with Extreme Coal) and a 20% fuel doubling chance.
jei.fastfurnacev2.diamond_fast_furnace: 300% speed (350% with Fast Coal; 400% with Extreme Coal) and a 25% fuel doubling chance.
jei.fastfurnacev2.fast_crusher: 150% speed (200% with Fast Coal; 250% with Extreme Coal) and a 10% chance to double the complete result.
jei.fastfurnacev2.iron_fast_crusher: 200% speed (250% with Fast Coal; 300% with Extreme Coal) and a 15% chance to double the complete result.
jei.fastfurnacev2.gold_fast_crusher: 250% speed (300% with Fast Coal; 350% with Extreme Coal) and a 20% chance to double the complete result.
jei.fastfurnacev2.diamond_fast_crusher: 300% speed (350% with Fast Coal; 400% with Extreme Coal) and a 25% chance to double the complete result.
jei.fastfurnacev2.fast_cobblestone: Mining stone without Silk Touch has a 10% chance to also drop Fast Cobblestone, +5% per Fortune level.
jei.fastfurnacev2.fast_coal: Mining coal ore without Silk Touch has a 10% chance to also drop Fast Coal, +5% per Fortune level. In Fast Furnaces and Crushers, burns 50–125% longer and adds 50 percentage points of speed.
jei.fastfurnacev2.fast_coal_block: Receives Fast Coal's speed and burn-duration bonuses in Fast Furnaces and Crushers.
jei.fastfurnacev2.extreme_coal_ore: Coal ore has a 5% chance to be replaced by Extreme Coal Ore.
jei.fastfurnacev2.extreme_coal: Doubles Fast Coal's speed and burn-duration bonuses in Fast Furnaces and Crushers. Supplies 7,200 Accelerator work at 5× speed.
jei.fastfurnacev2.extreme_coal_block: Receives Extreme Coal's speed and burn-duration bonuses in Fast Furnaces and Crushers. Supplies 8,000 Accelerator work at 5× speed.
jei.fastfurnacev2.deepslate_extreme_coal: Deepslate coal ore has a 5% chance to be replaced by Deepslate Extreme Coal Ore.
jei.fastfurnacev2.fast_ore: Matching ores have a 5% chance to be replaced by their Fast variants.
jei.fastfurnacev2.fast_iron_tool: Iron tool with 20% faster block breaking.
jei.fastfurnacev2.fast_gold_tool: Golden tool with 30% faster block breaking.
jei.fastfurnacev2.fast_diamond_tool: Diamond tool with 20% faster block breaking and a 5% chance to avoid durability damage.
jei.fastfurnacev2.fast_diamond_sword: Diamond sword with 20% faster attacks, 20% more attack damage, and a 5% chance to avoid durability damage.
jei.fastfurnacev2.extremely_fast_tool: Twice diamond-tool durability, 50% faster block breaking, built-in Fortune II, and a 5% chance to double block drops.
jei.fastfurnacev2.extremely_fast_sword: Twice diamond-sword durability, 50% faster attacks, built-in Looting II, a 5% chance to double kill drops, and a 10% chance to deal double damage.
jei.fastfurnacev2.accelerator_info: Requires lava on all four horizontal sides. Fast Coal and its block provide 3× processing speed; Extreme Coal and its block provide 5×.
jei.fastfurnacev2.alloyer_info: Uses only Extreme Coal. Each horizontal lava side reduces processing time by 100 ticks.
jei.fastfurnacev2.generator_info: Generates %s FE/t with ordinary fuel, %s FE/t with Fast Coal, or %s FE/t with Extreme Coal. Both special fuels burn for half their ordinary duration. Stores up to %s FE and automatically pushes energy to adjacent consumers.
jei.fastfurnacev2.battery_info: Stores up to %s FE and accepts or supplies up to %s FE/t on every side. Retains its exact stored energy when broken and placed again.
jei.fastfurnacev2.power_conduit_info: Transfers up to %s FE/t through each connected network. Mixed-tier networks use the slowest conduit's rate. Connects to adjacent energy handlers and other conduits.
